title: Is SRS a bit too heavy as a standard for transcripts? (2026-11-05)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Is srs just a bit too heavy as a standard for this?  We have planned to have an additional standard. 
or, since we are using only a subset of the functionality, will this actually be ok?

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-05; recorded verbatim, about holding transcripts as SRS records in a separate repository. Follows vignette e97cfe74.
